text:
Maya: Follow-up on active/active residency stuff. Quick question: if EU primary goes down, do we ever allow writes outside EU for tenants marked EU? We can't silently cross-border.
Alex: We shouldn't auto-flip. The RFC suggested header hints and tenant flags. Default is deny unless tenant explicitly opts into fallback.
Li: We also need an emergency operator path. Blocking everything will break customers during big outages.
Sanjay: Two-mode suggestion per tenant:
 - strict_residency -> proxy 409 with structured error, no cross-border write.
 - escrow_fallback -> proxy 202 + X-Escrow-ID, payload stored in EU escrow, later reconciled.
Maya: UX: prefer 409 with code `residency.block` over 451. 451 reads weird to users/legal.
Alex: Agreed. Standard response shapes: 409: {"error":"residency.block","reason":"tenant requires eu residency","help_url":"https://redwood.example/residency"} and 202: {"status":"escrowed","escrow_id":"<uuid>","info":"stored in EU escrow"}. (these are response bodies, they stay as strings here)
ops-bot: deploy:region-router v2.1 -> canary eu-west-1
Emily: Important: escrow must guarantee PII never leaves EU. EU-only KMS + EU operator access controls.
Li: Escrow store should be EU-only (S3-like), KMS per-tenant, minimal metadata (escrow_id, tenant, ts, op_hash). Reconcile job only runs in EU and writes audit entries.
Sanjay: Operational flow: escrow retention TTL, manual remit CLI `remit --escrow-id <id> --dst <region> --signoff <ticket>`, which appends audit and triggers transfer. Transfer requires legal ticket.
Maya: Runbook: preflight checks, legal signoff, TTL policy, escalate to security if >2h. Add header `X-Fallback-Allowed` for client opt-in.
Vince: SDKs should expose the error code and help_url so product can surface proper retry or support flow.
Alex: Draft headers for PR: `X-Residence: eu|us|asia` optional, `X-Fallback-Mode: strict|escrow|auto` (server-side), response header `X-Escrow-ID` on 202, telemetry tag `residency_status=blocked|escrowed|ok`.
Emily: Cost note: escrow is stateful - needs TTLs, replay queues, extra KMS keys. I'll provide infra delta after Li posts design.
Li: I'll upload escrow infra doc: EU-only store, per-tenant KMS, reconcile worker, audit trails.
Sanjay: I'll add runbook checklist and operator CLI steps for manual remit and approval.
Maya: Next steps: Alex PR for header+errors, Li infra doc, Emily cost estimate, SRE telemetry flag. Sync in 48h.
Maya: Filing RFC tracker ticket RFC-RESIDENCY-FOLLOWUP-276543. Closing thread for now, thanks.
